name: Barbarian
description: A ferocious warrior who uses fury and instinct to bring down foes.

name: Bard
description: A performer whose music works magic—a wanderer, a tale-teller, and a jack-of-all-trades.

name: Cleric
description: A master of divine magic and capable with weapons and armor.

name: Druid
description: One who gains divine spells from the power of nature, and can take the shape of animals.

name: Fighter
description: A warrior with exceptional combat capability and unequaled skill with weapons.

name: Monk
description: A martial artist whose unarmed strikes hit fast and hard—a master of exotic powers.

name: Paladin
description: A champion of justice and destroyer of evil, protected and strengthened by divine powers.

name: Ranger
description: A cunning, skilled warrior of the wilderness.

name: Rogue
description: A tricky, skillful scout and spy who wins the day with stealth and cunning rather than brute force.

name: Sorcerer
description: A spellcaster with inborn magical ability.

name: Wizard
description: A potent spellcaster schooled in the arcane arts.
